# P1 · S6 · 0001 — Auth (OIDC PKCE) + secure token store

> **Severity:** Foundation · **Delegation:** FORBIDDEN
> The shared authentication core: OIDC Authorization-Code-with-PKCE against Authentik,
> token persistence via `expect/actual` secure storage, and automatic 401 refresh wired into
> the S4 networking seam. Per ADR-008.

1 No red-as-green  2 No scope narrowing  3 No skip-and-assume  4 No stubs as final

9 No silent drift  10 Log ends with EXIT=<int> and STATUS=<DONE|BLOCKED>

## Single Goal

A platform-agnostic `AuthService` that performs OIDC PKCE (build authorize URL + verifier,
exchange code→tokens, refresh, logout/revoke), persists tokens through an `expect/actual`
`SecureTokenStore`, and feeds the S4 `TokenProvider` + `onUnauthorized` so any 401 triggers a
single refresh-and-retry. The browser/redirect step is delegated to the platform (W4/A4/P5)
via an injected `AuthBrowser` interface — the shared core owns all crypto + token logic.

## Spec

- **PKCE**: S256 verifier/challenge, `state`+`nonce`, configurable issuer/clientId/redirect/scope
  (from P0/0009 runbook). No client secret (public native client).
- **Token model**: access/refresh/id tokens + expiry; refresh proactively before expiry and
  reactively on 401 (single-flight — concurrent 401s share one refresh).
- **SecureTokenStore `expect/actual`**: android = EncryptedSharedPreferences/Keystore;
  apple = Keychain (kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlock). commonTest uses an in-memory fake.
- **Session state**: `StateFlow<AuthState>` (SignedOut/Authenticating/SignedIn/Refreshing/Error).
- **AuthBrowser** interface: `fun authorize(url): RedirectResult` — actual impls live in platform
  modules (ASWebAuthenticationSession / Custom Tabs / WebAuthenticationBroker). Not implemented here.
- **Testing**: mock token endpoint (Ktor MockEngine) — verify PKCE params, code exchange, refresh,
  single-flight 401, revoke; verify store round-trip via the fake. No real browser/network.

## Implementation steps

1. PKCE util + authorize-URL builder + token-exchange/refresh/revoke calls over the S4 client.
2. `SecureTokenStore` `expect` + android/apple `actual` impls; in-memory fake for tests.
3. Wire `TokenProvider`/`onUnauthorized` (single-flight refresh) into the S4 client.
4. `AuthState` StateFlow; `AuthBrowser` injection point.
5. MockEngine + fake-store test suite; run gate.

## Gate

```powershell
Push-Location apps/shared/core
./gradlew :core:allTests 2>&1 | Tee-Object $log -Append; "TEST_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE" | Tee-Object $log -Append
./gradlew ktlintCheck 2>&1 | Tee-Object $log -Append; "LINT_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE" | Tee-Object $log -Append
Pop-Location
& ./apps/tools/check-placeholders.ps1 -Path apps/shared/core -Language kotlin *>$null; "PH_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE" | Tee-Object $log -Append
# EXIT=0 only if TEST/LINT/PH all 0
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] PKCE (S256, state, nonce) verified; code exchange + refresh + revoke covered.
- [ ] Single-flight 401 refresh-and-retry proven; concurrent 401s share one refresh.
- [ ] android Keystore + apple Keychain `actual`s implemented; fake-store round-trip green.
- [ ] No real browser/network in tests; ktlint + placeholder clean.
- [ ] `EXIT=0` / `STATUS=DONE`.

## Out of Scope

Platform browser/redirect UI (W4/A4/P5), biometric unlock UX, login screens.
